consultasBanco.descricao: Mesmo tipo de contrato, checklist diferente pela característica do imóvel (casa nova x usado)
consultasBanco.sql: SELECT contract_id, array_agg(requirement_type ORDER BY created_at, requirement_code) AS tipos FROM legal.contract_requirements WHERE contract_id IN (:a, :b) GROUP BY contract_id

consultasBanco.descricao: Versão anterior fechada (nunca editada) e auditoria com o motivo
consultasBanco.sql: SELECT v.version_number, v.effective_until IS NOT NULL AS fechada, (SELECT reason FROM audit.audit_log WHERE action = 'legal.requirement_rules.publish' AND entity_id = :id) AS motivo FROM core.rule_versions v JOIN core.rules r ON r.id = v.rule_id AND r.code = 'REG-JUR-001' ORDER BY v.version_number
